metaDescription: Order custom 16 oz martini glasses for your next event. Perfect for branding with logos. Shop at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: For events where a classic martini is the star, 16 oz martini glasses offer the ideal capacity for a generous pour without overfilling. This size works well for promotional giveaways at corporate parties, trade show receptions, or hospitality suites where recipients appreciate a full-sized glass they can reuse at home. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or etching for a polished look that stands out on the bar cart.
heroAltText: Custom 16 oz martini glasses with a clear glass bowl and long stem, ready for logo imprinting.
